observations: Red welding machine sitting on its retail box.
Brand 'MAXMECH' and model 'MINI-180' are clearly printed on the side of the device.
The box also displays 'MAXMECH MINI-180' and '4.3KVA'.

The unit appears to be in clean, possibly new or lightly used condition.
